name: W2LIST_GSEAGEN_PS
comment: Constant factor in the weight (global generation weight)

name: W2LIST_GSEAGEN_EG
comment: E gamma

name: W2LIST_GSEAGEN_XSEC_MEAN
comment: Average interaction cross-section per nucleon along the neutrino path throuh the Earth (in units of m2)

name: W2LIST_GSEAGEN_COLUMN_DEPTH
comment: Line integrated column density through the Earth for the neutrino direction

name: W2LIST_GSEAGEN_P_EARTH
comment: Transmission probability in the Earth (XSEC_MEAN and COLUMN_DEPTH used to compute PEarth)

name: W2LIST_GSEAGEN_WATER_INT_LEN
comment: Interaction length in pure water in m

name: W2LIST_GSEAGEN_P_SCALE
comment: Interaction probability scale

name: W2LIST_GSEAGEN_BX
comment: Bjorken x

name: W2LIST_GSEAGEN_BY
comment: Bjorken y

name: W2LIST_GSEAGEN_ICHAN
comment: Interaction channel

name: W2LIST_GSEAGEN_CC
comment: Charged current interaction flag

name: W2LIST_GSEAGEN_DISTAMAX
comment: distance added to the radius of the generation surface (relevant for CORSIKA muons)

name: W2LIST_GSEAGEN_WATERXSEC
comment: inclusive xsec in water

name: W2LIST_GSEAGEN_XSEC
comment: exclusive total cross section of the interaction

name: W2LIST_GSEAGEN_DXSEC
comment: differential cross section of the interaction (dsigma/dxdy) extracted from genie

name: W2LIST_GSEAGEN_TARGETA
comment: number of nuclons in the target

name: W2LIST_GSEAGEN_TARGETZ
comment: number of protons in the target

name: W2LIST_GSEAGEN_VERINCAN
comment: flag indicating the vertex is in the can

name: W2LIST_GSEAGEN_LEPINCAN
comment: flag indicating a lepton reached the can

name: W2LIST_GSEAGEN_N_RETRIES
comment: Number of extra chances given to each CORSIKA shower to hit the can

name: W2LIST_GSEAGEN_CUSTOM_YAW
comment: user-specified rotation of CORSIKA showers (around z-axis)

name: W2LIST_GSEAGEN_CUSTOM_PITCH
comment: user-specified rotation of CORSIKA showers (around y-axis)

name: W2LIST_GSEAGEN_CUSTOM_ROLL
comment: user-specified rotation of CORSIKA showers (around x-axis)

name: W2LIST_GSEAGEN_W
comment: Invariant Hadronic Mass extracted from genie
